parents.subject: Game Studies and Design
parents.course: Special Topics in Game Studies & Design

ns2:section.sectionText: This course is intended to be a deeper dive into the 2D/2.5D systems of the video game development engine Unreal Engine. We'll be covering the Paper2D and PaperZD systems. Over the course of the class you will be putting together a series of simple demos that can be used as both a personal reference for what you've learned as well as a demo for your portfolio. The course is intended for both those with beginner experience in Unreal Engine or experience developers who wish to learn more about Unreal Engine and its 2D systems. BYOL course (Bring Your Own Laptop)
